jsonld_raw.name: (220 G) WARM CHERRY SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Warm Cherry | A spicy and enveloping accord where cherry recalls the orchards of southern Poland, warm and juicy. The creamy heart of sandalwood and ginger provides depth and character, and a soft, addictive base of lactonic woods and musk.


FRAGRANCE NOTES
Top notes: cardamom, nutmeg, cumin
Heart notes: sandalwood, ginger
Base notes: lactonic woods, musk
